versions.content: If EthTrcv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest() is called and the internal cable diagnostic state is ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall store the link state request per Ethernet transceiver and pro- ceed as specified in [SWS_EthTrcv_00162].

If EthTrcv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest() is called and the internal cable diagnostic state is ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall store the link state request per Ethernet transceiver and pro- ceed as specified in [SWS_EthTrcv_00162].
